# Sattasatikakkhandhaka (Kd 22)

**ID:** Kd 22
**Section:** Khandhaka (kd)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Sattasatikakkhandhaka
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/vin02m3.mul11.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Following formal procedural inquiry, the assembly confirms that monastics are forbidden to accept money. Scholars have frequently viewed the *Sattasatikakkhandhaka*, together with the preceding twenty-first Khandhaka (*Pañcasatikakkhandhaka*), as a later addition functioning as a historical appendix to the *Cullavagga* [Hazra 1994]. Textual analysis also notes that earlier Khandhakas are referenced within this chapter under varying designations, such as *uposathasaṁyutta* and *campeyyaka vinayavatthu*, indicating non-standardized chapter nomenclature at the time of composition [Sung 1999].

 An English translation of the chapter has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
